verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a public exceptions-reporting API: a JSON payload POSTed to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices. Its docs point users of unsupported languages and frameworks to that API, so custom clients can report errors without an official SDK. The evidence only shows the endpoint and the fallback guidance, not the full payload schema or wider event ingestion, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented payload schema/field reference in evidence, a documented ingestion endpoint for non-error (Insights) events, a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI paths 404), independent corroboration of third-party or compatible clients sending events.
